definitions.name: W2D.MEAN
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV 0 [ ADD ] FOLD MV LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a non-empty numeric Vector, as a bare scalar

definitions.name: W2D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'ML' BIND MS ML 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS ML 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even)

definitions.name: W2D.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value of a number, lifts lane by lane over a Vector

definitions.name: W2D.DEVS
definitions.note: each number minus the mean of the Vector, in order

definitions.name: W2D.VARIANCE
definitions.body: W2D.DEVS 'VD' BIND VD VD MUL W2D.MEAN
definitions.note: population variance of a numeric Vector, as a bare scalar

definitions.name: W2D.SUMS
definitions.body: 'SP' BIND SP [ 0 GET ] MAP SP [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'SG' BIND SG KEYS SG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs to a Record key -> sum of its amounts, keys in order of first appearance

definitions.name: W2D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES W1A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: key of a Record whose numeric value is largest; the first such key on ties

definitions.name: W2D.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word to Title case: first letter upper, the rest lower

definitions.name: W2D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DP' BIND 1 DP RANGE 'DD' BIND DD 0 DP DD G0A.MOD 1 LT SELECT [ 0 GT ] FILTER
definitions.note: ascending positive divisors of a positive integer

definitions.name: W2D.ISPRIME
definitions.note: whether a positive integer is prime (1 is not)

definitions.name: W2D.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'CX' BIND 1 CX 2 DIV CX 3 MUL 1 ADD CX 2 G0A.MOD 0 EQ SELECT CX 1 EQ SELECT
definitions.note: one Collatz step: even halves, odd becomes 3x+1, 1 stays 1

definitions.name: W2D.FIBSTEP
definitions.body: 'FP' BIND FP 1 GET FP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: [ F(k) F(k+1) ] -> [ F(k+1) F(k+2) ], a SCAN/FOLD step for Fibonacci pairs

definitions.name: W2D.LINE
definitions.body: 'LO' BIND LO 'price' GET 'LP' BIND 0 LP LP NIL? SELECT LO 'qty' GET MUL
definitions.note: order Record to qty times price, 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: W2D.REVENUE
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ W2D.LINE ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: orders JSON String to the total of qty times price over the priced orders

solutions.ledger.debtors: W2D.SUMS 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E [ 1 GET ] MAP W1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ W2D.CAP ] MAP W1A.UNWORDS
solutions.number.binary: 'N' BIND N 2 5 0 RANGE POW DIV FLOOR 2 G0A.MOD 'B' BIND B B W1A.ARGMAX DROP STR JOIN
solutions.number.collatz: 'N' BIND N 1 COLLECT [ 130 ] 0 FILL N [ ADD W2D.CSTEP ] SCAN CONCAT [ 1 GT ] FILTER LENGTH
solutions.number.fib_index: 'N' BIND [ 12 ] 0 FILL [ 0 1 ] [ ADD W2D.FIBSTEP ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ N LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
solutions.orders.unpriced: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.top_sku: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ [ 'sku' 'qty' ] GET ] MAP W2D.SUMS W2D.TOPKEY
solutions.orders.tag_counts: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V V W2D.MEDIAN SUB W2D.ABS W2D.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.stats.range: SORT 'S' BIND S -1 GET S 0 GET SUB
solutions.stats.normalize: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND S 0 GET 'MN' BIND V MN SUB S -1 GET MN SUB DIV
solutions.text.longest: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.text.acronym: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
